name: Shattered Arena
tagline: Punch a rival into the pit. Escort your troopers through the portal. Run the enemy out of tickets.
summary: Two teams share one arena and start with 500 tickets each. A ring-out costs five. Every ten enemy hero deaths send five Rift Troopers straight down the middle.
description: Shattered Arena by CosmicCapt brings SMITE’s Corrupted Arena format to Deadlock. Heavy melee can empty a rival’s stamina and send them over the edge. A fresh wave of troopers marches every 30 seconds. Protect yours on the way to the enemy portal, or slip away to claim a camp buff. At five minutes, islands rise from the pits carrying Sinner’s Sacrifices. Land a heavy hit to earn a ticket back for your team. Once a team runs out of tickets, both sides can settle the score on a separate platform in an optional last-team-standing bonus round.

howToPlay.title: Line up a ring-out
howToPlay.body: Bait a rival near a pit, then land a heavy melee facing the edge. A hero death costs their team five tickets.

howToPlay.title: Walk the wave in
howToPlay.body: Each friendly trooper that reaches the enemy portal takes one ticket. Every ten enemy hero deaths summon five Rift Troopers worth two tickets apiece.

howToPlay.title: Claw tickets back
howToPlay.body: At five minutes, jump onto a rising island and hit its Sinner’s Sacrifice with heavy melee. Get off before the island sinks.

whatsNew: First Hideout release of CosmicCapt’s Shattered Arena 0.2.7.
